description: Navigate the AI's currently active tab to a URL in the real Chromium browser the user is sitting in front of. The page loads, JavaScript runs, cookies/redirects/captchas behave exactly as they would for a human. Use this to follow a link from a previous result, change the URL of a tab you already opened, or move through a multi-page flow. Prefer playwright_new_tab when starting a fresh task so you don't clobber an existing tab. Refused if the target tab is the qwen-web TUI or the user is currently focused on it.

waitUntil.description: When to consider navigation complete. Default is 'load'. Use 'networkidle' to wait until no network requests for 500ms.

name: playwright_navigate
